params.name: siteUrl
params.description: URL of the Webex site which the API queries common settings of the meeting's configuration from. If not specified, the API will query from the site administrator's preferred site. All available Webex sites and the preferred site of the user can be retrieved by the [Get Site List](/docs/api/v1/meeting-preferences/get-site-list) API.

items.docs:
Site administrators can use this API to get a list of functions, options, and privileges that are configured for their Webex service sites.

* If `siteUrl` is specified, common settings of the meeting's configuration of the specified site will be queried; otherwise, the API will query from the site administrator's preferred site. All available Webex sites and preferred site of the user can be retrieved by [Get Site List](/docs/api/v1/meeting-preferences/get-site-list) API.
Site administrators can use this API to update the option of features, options and privileges that are configured for their WebEx service sites.
